messages:
maya: kicking off preflight for tonight's cross-service window (22:00 UTC). scope: API pin -> v2.3, runtime kernel switch -> kernel-opt-12, console schema -> v5 (backward-compatible), router header swap (x-rdw-route -> x-rdw-route-v2). want to run a staged canary: 5% -> 30% -> 100%. calling out blockers now please.

priya: noted. release notes draft is in the docs/handbook repo, will paste link in #release-notes in 10m. need to confirm migration steps for console schema (non-blocking for reads). also we should include exact rollback triggers in the release note.

zach: router header swap requires a 2-host config change for the edge tier (edge-a, edge-b). one host in staging failed the header flag rollout earlier, need SRE to confirm flag rollout plan.

tom: can we do 5% canary for 30m, validate p95 and 5xx, then 30% for 45m? also we should do a traffic-steer test to ensure KV cache warming on runtime isn't regressing.

maya: yes to canary durations. pinned thresholds: rollback if 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline for 10m OR model-quality eval failure (automated eval returns >2% deteriation). manual hold if console throws >3 errors/min for 10m.

deploy-bot: PRECHECK: api:v2.3 image exists, runtime:kernel-opt-12 available in eu-west, console:v5 schema migration plan present. router flag rollout status: flag missing on edge-b.staging -> action required.

zach: @deploy-bot any quick commands to force the flag on edge-b?

deploy-bot: run: ```ssh edge-b && sudo /opt/flagsctl set x-rdw-route-v2 true && systemctl reload edge-proxy``` will propagate in ~20s. also: `deploy-bot preflight --check-cache-warmup runtime` returns FAIL on staging (cache hit rate 12% vs 65% baseline).

maya: cache warmup fail is expected after kernel switch; plan: run a warmup traffic replay for canary nodes pre-cutover (10m synthetic traffic) and re-check. if still bad, back off kernel switch to a subset.

priya: adding to release note: warmup + traffic-replay step before moving from 5% -> 30%. I'll include the exact commands.

tom: we need to pin API variants: v2.3 (primary) and v2.2 fallback. Routing policy: prefer v2.3, fallback to v2.2 on 503s with exponential backoff for 5s then 20s. who owns the fallback circuit?

maya: runtime owns circuit (team runtime). we'll coordinate automated fallback via router rules (router team implements). config sample we'll use: ```canary: [{percent:5, duration:30m}, {percent:30, duration:45m}] fallback_policy: {on_503: route_to: v2.2, backoff_ms: [5000,20000]}```

zach: SRE: please pre-stage the router rule in staging and run the failover test (simulate 503 from v2.3) before the window. ping @oncall once pre-staged.

deploy-bot: ACTION: scheduled window at 1765960800 (22:00 UTC). preflight job created: /jobs/preflight-1765932468. Warmup job created: /jobs/warmup-1765932468. will post completion.

priya: quick question on rollback comms — if we trigger rollback, do we auto-open a release-war-room ticket or ping #incidents? prefer release-war-room + incident channel. also include the rollback reason in ops ticket.

maya: yes: rollback => open war-room ticket, page SRE, and post release summary in #eng-releases. I'll be the primary for the first 30m of canary, then handoff to tom for 30% phase.

tom: ack. I'll be ready to run the runtime revert (if needed) with the one-liner: ```runtime-deploy rollback --to-tag kernel-opt-11 --target canary-nodes``` and we'll pin router back to header-old on rollback.

zach: I'll pre-approve the edge-b flag change once SRE confirms the staging replay passes.

deploy-bot: PRECHECK COMPLETE: job /jobs/preflight-1765932468 -> WARNINGS: staging runtime cache-warmup FAIL (needs replay), router flag missing on edge-b. blocking: true.

maya: ok blockers noted. plan: postpone live window by 1 hour if staging replay doesn't pass in next 20m. if stage passes, proceed as scheduled. everyone please react :eyes: when you've read this. :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

zach: :eyes:

tom: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks, will update in 15m with staging warmup result.
